systems.country_label: Plateforme de Données Ouvertes (ODP) du Togo
systems.owner: INSEED (national statistics office), with sector ministries' focal points

note: Statistics office data portal (INSEED, migration ODP 1.0 to 2.0, training financed by the World Bank); no open data policy or government-run national open data portal is stated, so no fact.

facts.fact: A post on opendata.gouv.tg dated 18 December 2024 announces the official launch ceremony on 19 December 2024 of the Open Data and Geoportail Open Data platforms giving access to data on Togo's socio-economic infrastructure; the post carries the MENTD and ATD hashtags but names no policy and no publishing bodies or dataset counts.

systems.owner: Government (page on opendata.gouv.tg, hashtags MENTD and ATD)
Government (launched with the open data platform, hashtags MENTD and ATD)

facts.fact: Togo First, 18 November 2025, recalls that in December 2024 Togo launched two public data dissemination platforms, Open Data and the Geoportail Open Data, run by the Agence Togo Digital; it does not tie them to an open data policy.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Efficacité de l'action publique et de la Transformation numérique, with GIZ support

note: The article is about the ONN digital-sector observatory (class other); only its closing reference to the December 2024 portals gives a fact.

facts.fact: La Voix de la Nation reports that the Open Data portal (opendata.gouv.tg) and the Geoportail (geodata.gouv.tg) were officially launched in December 2024 by the digital ministry through its operational arm, the Agence Togo Digital; the article names no open data policy.

The article states the Geoportail centralises data from 23 ministries and more than 550 administrative units, drawn from a 2021-2022 collection under the PRISE project; the article is dated 2025-01-08 and gives no date for the figure, so that date is used.

note: Reports a first national open data conference on 30 November 2018 and training workshops planned; it names no policy, drafting or open data portal (togo.tg is an institutional portal).
The open data portal answer is already held as TGO-001, TGO-002 and TGO-003.
